meaning.en: A disease caused by infestation with parasitic worms.
meaning.vi: Là bệnh do nhiễm giun ký sinh.

meaning.en: A disease caused or characterized by parasitic worms in the body.
meaning.vi: Là bệnh do giun ký sinh trong cơ thể gây ra hoặc đặc trưng.

meaning.en: Infestation with or disease caused by parasitic worms.
meaning.vi: Nhiễm hoặc bệnh do giun ký sinh.
